title: hebea arenaria
intro: Hebea arenaria, commonly known as the Coral Hebe, is a flowering plant species native to New Zealand. The Coral Hebe is a shrubby perennial plant that is valued for its potential health benefits, which include antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, contributing to its potential therapeutic actions in reducing inflammation and improving cardiovascular health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties. The health benefits of Hebea arenaria include potential anti-cancer and antimicrobial activities, making it a subject of interest in modern herbal medicine.
